lens: Gawande and Weinberg: release sequencing, trust boundaries, truthful preparation evidence, secret exceptions and upgrade safety

counterweight_triage.concern: Preparation could appear complete or bypass final subject verification.
counterweight_triage.disposition: No current blocker established. run_quality_engine.py defers exactly one selected pytest-release row and marks it unestablished. run_quality_engine_receipt.py persists that partial status and fails preparation on receipt emission failure. publish_release_common.py selects preparation only for the recognized native command; resume explicitly requests the full lane. The bound release disposition retains receipt-failure and renamed-gate negative controls, including target-bound mutant evidence.

counterweight_triage.concern: A partial or stale receipt could authorize the final push.
counterweight_triage.disposition: The supplied receipt owner rejects preparation commands, incomplete semantic passes and missing pytest-release scope. Its final validator checks repository identity, clean HEAD/tree, materialized export and pushed-object coverage. Resume runs quality before publication and uses a fresh temporary receipt location. These guards support the bounded review; actual hook fallback and release invocation counts remain execution obligations.

counterweight_triage.concern: Release publication, installation and issue closure remain unproved.
counterweight_triage.disposition: Obligatory next phases, not defects requiring another code review. Execute prepare, review its honestly pending claims, then resume with current full quality and fresh-checkout proof before publication. Preserve public readback, installation refresh, expected-version/doctor comparison, issue-specific behavioral evidence and child-before-parent graph closure. The earlier integration pass does not satisfy these boundaries.

counterweight_triage.concern: Secret suppression or upgrade instructions could weaken release safety.
counterweight_triage.disposition: The new generic-api-key exceptions combine exact paths with a specific digest-line shape or the exact collision/duplicate matched value. Integration observations retain the complete-protocol positive control and a same-file synthetic-key refusal. Release notes retain update/version/doctor instructions; the adapter explicitly describes configured-branch updates, without promising tag-pinned installation.

counterweight_triage.concern: Pilot and context limitations could be converted into unsupported completion or efficiency claims.
counterweight_triage.disposition: The notes correctly disclose no demonstrated efficiency gain, higher valid-candidate cost and invalid lower-tier attribution. Context observations also preserve interventions and missing semantic provenance. Keep these limitations visible through issue-specific closeout; neither pilot repair nor a favorable efficiency result is required for this safety review.

next_move: Proceed to release-owned preparation and claims review, then final resume/publication verification. Record actual scheduling and receipt-consumer behavior, public/install observations and issue-specific graph proof before claiming release or Goal completion.
non_claims: Pass applies only to this bounded review of the supplied semantic bytes; it is not publication approval or a completed release verdict.
No workspace edits, test execution, live publication, installation or provider graph inspection were performed.
Test outcomes are reported evidence in the bound dispositions; unbound test sources and the pre-push hook body were not independently inspected.
